name: Takanashi Yasunobu
source:
Wakana's husband, a company employee.

He moved into the apartment and soon after moved out, he is assigned to work alone. He is somewhat overprotective of his wife, who grew up as a young lady.

He is also trying to raise his children and be a good father and to his children, He decided to live with his parents without consulting his wife.

[From [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc074/character.html]official site[/url]]
